A free Slido alternative for markdown slides

SLOTH is a free slide tool that runs in your browser. Write your deck in markdown, share a live view with your audience by link and collect survey responses during your talk.

Open SLOTH

What SLOTH offers

  • Slides and surveys live together in one markdown file.
  • Four question types: single choice, multiple choice, rating from 1 to 5 and free text.
  • Your audience opens a link in a browser and follows your slides as you present.
  • Responses are saved as a CSV file inside your browser tab, ready to download.
  • Slides can run Node.js code during your talk.
  • SLOTH is free to use.

How to run a survey with SLOTH

  1. Open SLOTH and choose New to start a deck, or Upload to bring in a markdown file.
  2. Choose Survey, add your questions and add the survey to your deck.
  3. Choose Present and share the link with your audience.
  4. Choose Download to save your project, with the responses as CSV, in a zip file.

Where Slido may suit you better

SLOTH saves responses to a CSV file for you to review after the session, and you write and drive it from the keyboard. If you need live poll results or audience Q&A with upvoting on screen during your talk, Slido is the stronger choice.

Runs on your device

SLOTH runs a Node.js process inside your browser tab through BrowserPod. Your decks, files and survey responses stay in the tab until you download them.
